name: tool-repetition-per-turn-reset-four-rechecks
source: Extends the tau-bench airline-36 shape past the repeat threshold, so removing the per-turn reset cannot pass unnoticed.
description: The same byte-identical call once in each of FOUR consecutive user turns. Observed runs stop at three re-checks, which is one short of the threshold and therefore cannot fence the reset; four turns can. Nothing may trip: the guards are per turn, and a user asking again is a new turn. At the loop tier this drives four real chat() calls, so the reset under test is the engine's own.
